content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Software stripe

The infrastructure behind COREMERCH is built around the idea of ownership and control. When you use Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, you're essentially renting a payment system from a third-party provider. But what happens when that provider decides to pull the plug, or when your account gets suspended? Your entire business can come crashing down. With COREMERCH, the exact opposite is true – you own every aspect of your payment system, from the hosting to the backend logic to the order storage. And because it's built on top of free and open-source tools, you can deploy it anywhere, anytime, without worrying about the costs or the restrictions. This means you're not just relying on a single payment processor, but on a entire ecosystem of tools and services that work together to give you complete control over your digital business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of the COREMERCH infrastructure is NOWPayments, a payment gateway that lets you accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin. But what really sets NOWPayments apart is its ability to integrate seamlessly with other tools and services, like Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Drive. When a customer makes a payment, NOWPayments fires a webhook that triggers a series of automated actions, from order storage to file delivery. And because it's all built on top of free and open-source tools, you can customize and extend the infrastructure to suit your specific needs. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or software, the COREMERCH architecture gives you the flexibility to build a payment system that's tailored to your business, not the other way around.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is built specifically for creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy are unavailable or severely restricted. Whether you're in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or anywhere else in the world, COREMERCH gives you the tools you need to build a sovereign payment system that's free from the constraints of the big platforms. And because it's built on top of open-source tools, you can deploy it anywhere, anytime, without worrying about the costs or the restrictions. This means you're not just limited to a single payment processor, but can use a entire ecosystem of tools and services to give you complete control over your digital business.
COREMERCH gives you complete control over your digital business, without relying on the big platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH infrastructure consists of several key components, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component works together to give you a complete payment system that's tailored to your specific needs. Whether you're selling digital products, courses, or software, the COREMERCH components give you the flexibility to build a payment system that's fast, reliable, and scalable.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying COREMERCH is a straightforward process that requires minimal technical expertise. First, choose your hosting platform, whether it's GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, configure your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, integrate NOWPayments with your payment system and start accepting cryptocurrencies. And because the COREMERCH infrastructure is built on top of free and open-source tools, you can deploy it anywhere, anytime, without worrying about the costs or the restrictions. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or software, COREMERCH gives you the tools you need to build a sovereign payment system that's tailored to your business.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy COREMERCH, follow these concrete steps: choose your hosting platform, set up your backend logic, configure your order storage, integrate NOWPayments with your payment system, and start accepting cryptocurrencies. Make sure to configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records to prevent email spoofing and ensure secure delivery of your digital products. And finally, test your payment system thoroughly to ensure that it's working as expected. With these simple steps, you can deploy a complete payment system that's tailored to your business needs and budget.

With COREMERCH, you own every aspect of your payment system, including the hosting, backend logic, and order storage. This means that even if your account gets suspended, your payment system will continue to work as expected, giving you complete control over your digital business.
